mutant.description: SIX negative controls, because every substantive read in this order is a zero or an unchanged value, and an unchanged value is exactly what a dead instrument also returns. (1) STOP 1's empty diff was run beside a control printing ALL paths changed across the same commit range. (2) The before and after handler reads were taken by DOWNLOADING the deployed package and hashing its member, never from a filename or a config field. (3) The env was proven key by key with a sha256 PER VALUE, so a change to one of the eight untouched values could not hide behind a correct key count of 9. (4) The value typed was hash-compared against the already-live COMMENTARY_ALLOWED_FIRMS before the edit, so 'the two lists are equal' is measured rather than asserted. (5) The 401 on the package door was bounded by a negative control on a route that does not exist. (6) The control ticket was captured as a whole-item sha256 before and re-hashed after, so (d) is a byte comparison rather than a glance at a few fields.

The one read that failed as an instrument is recorded rather than dropped: my first attempt at after-read (c) used a hostname I invented, portal.opalinvest.com, which does not resolve, and curl returned 000 on all three calls INCLUDING the control. determinism.method: The artifact was NOT rebuilt -- this is an env-only apply and a rebuild would have been the defect the order's STOP names -- so determinism here is about the after-state being read on independent planes that could disagree. The code was read on three: the config field (CodeSha256), the DOWNLOADED package bytes hashed per member, and a replan. The env value was read on three: the saved planfile's JSON before the apply, the rendered plan diff, and a live get-function-configuration after it. The value typed was additionally hash-compared against a DIFFERENT live env key, COMMENTARY_ALLOWED_FIRMS, which the signed half says must equal it.
determinism.observed: The three code planes agree and all say UNCHANGED: CodeSha256 d2w1YJ8AU7vvBufC... before and after, the downloaded member c40036677aae... before and after from two separate fresh downloads, and the replan 0-diff. THE ENV PLANES DISAGREED IN PRESENTATION AND AGREED IN FACT, the same instructive detail as pk2 and now in the opposite direction: the rendered plan printed the BEFORE value as null while the planfile JSON and the live read both say it was the empty string, present and empty. In pk2 the rendered diff called an ADDED empty string null; here it calls an EXISTING empty string null. So the rendering is not a reading of the world in either direction, and a seat that tells key-absent from key-present-and-empty by reading the rendered diff cannot -- which is what row TCKT_VNEXT-D2-S43 now records. The after value is 49financial,cottonwood,inflection at length 33, hashing to 66d47236daafbe12, identical to COMMENTARY_ALLOWED_FIRMS, so 'the two lists stay equal' is measured and not asserted.
